Address,Ⓒv. t.ⒹAmaMtr 10 A; saM-aBi-A-BAz 1 A, aBiDA 3 U, saMbuD c., Alap, 1 P; ‘a(ddress)ed his mind to Surya’ sUryaM manasADyAyat; ‘a(ddress) me as is wont with you’ (mAM prati) yaTAByastamaBiDIyatAm (U. 1).
Ⓑ
 2 nAma grah 9 P, nAmagrAhaM vad 1 P or Ahve 1 P.
Ⓑ
 3 prahi 5 P, prez 10.
Ⓔs.ⒹaBi-saM-BAzaRaM, saMboDanaM &c.
Ⓑ
 2 vacanaM, AlApaH; ‘mode of a(ddress)’ AmaMtraRapadaM; saMSayite pariRaye nEza samudAcAraH (S. 5). ‘not the proper mode of a(ddress)’; ‘of agreeable a(ddress)’ maDurAlApa, priyaMvada.
Ⓑ
 3 pawutA, dakzatA, nEpuRyaM.
Ⓑ
 4 (Of a letter) bAhyanAman n.; adattabAhyanAmAnaM leKaM (Mu. 1) ‘a letter without any a(ddress) upon it’; ‘send the letter to my a(ddress)’ datta-liKita-madbAhyanAma (mAmuddiSya) patraM prezaya.
Ⓑ
 5 (Place of residence &c.) nAmaDAmaviSezAH.
